content: Long-running browser/agent sessions in Kubernetes fail through zombie process accumulation and OOM: containers without an init process do not reap orphans (k3s #5675 zombie process overflow; pid-exhaustion labs), headless Chrome agents leak zombie processes consuming 100% CPU (hermes-agent #17388), and memory leaks drive OOMKills that lose all session state mid-run. Mitigations: tini/dumb-init or k8s sharedProcessNamespace for reaping, per-job pod isolation (one session one pod), active pgrep-based cleanup sweeps, memory limits plus leak monitoring, and checkpointing session state so a killed pod can resume or at least report.
